Who invented donuts, and how did they become one of the world's favorite treats? Join Dr. Binocs as he uncovers the fascinating history of donuts, from their early origins to the iconic ring-shaped snack we know today. Discover fun facts, surprising stories, and the science behind this delicious dessert in a fun and kid-friendly adventure! Perfect for curious minds who love learning something new.
Make sure you watch the whole video to know all the answers to your curious questions!
